adjudication.proven: The archived native guest has four complete, consecutive, register-matching six-step I_NMI_M1X1 stack save bursts in the bounded original result/postresult window. At native frames 5781,5786,5787,5788, native 16-bit PHA writes accumulator words 4004,4040,4004,4004 respectively, with original native SP before/after inferred from the emitted source. All qualifying sequences match PHB/DB, PHD/D, PHX/X, PHY/Y, 16-bit PHA/A, 8-bit PHA with M=1 after SEP. The frame 5781 A=4004, stack 01DD event exactly reproduces the separately proven raw PHA writer.
